help: Publish the report-only HIP-3 roster checkpoint (public wallet only)
description: Poll a configured HIP-3 market roster (a cohort profile's HIP-3 assets with --config, or explicit --market dex:ASSET=MAX_LEVERAGE values) and publish a durable report-only checkpoint, streaming one JSON line per poll. It loads only the public wallet address and never builds an execution client. Exit 0 when any poll succeeded (or none ran), 1 when every poll failed, 2 when the roster cannot be resolved.

options.help: cohort profile whose HIP-3 assets (and venue_max_leverage) form the roster
explicit roster market as dex:ASSET=MAX_LEVERAGE; repeatable
roster checkpoint JSON to publish atomically
stop after this many polls (default: run until stopped)
directory for the rolling HIP-3 asset-context archive
